items.title: Lattice's Q2 Earnings Top Estimates on AI Demand and Record Revenue
items.summary: LSCC posts record Q2 revenues and beats earnings estimates as AI data center demand and industrial recovery fuel growth, with upbeat Q3 guidance.

items.title: Pinterest's Q2 Earnings Top Estimates on AI-Led Ad Growth
items.summary: PINS beats Q2 earnings estimates as AI-powered ads, stronger monetization and record user growth drive revenue higher and support a stronger outlook.

items.title: Arista Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates on Solid Revenue Growth
items.summary: ANET tops Q2 estimates as AI, cloud and enterprise networking demand fuel 37.7% revenue growth, with Q3 revenues projected at about $3.3 billion.

items.title: Viasat Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates Despite Lower Y/Y Revenues
items.summary: VSAT posts Q1 fiscal 2027 earnings beat despite a revenue miss, as lower interest expense narrows losses and management reaffirms growth expectations.

items.title: SpaceX Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates on AI Cloud and Starlink Growth
items.summary: SPCX beats Q2 estimates as revenue surged 91.9%, fueled by AI cloud deals and Starlink growth, while heavy capex reshaped cash deployment.

items.title: ADTRAN Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Healthy Revenue Growth
items.summary: ADTN beats earnings and revenue estimates in Q2 2026 with optical networking sales growth and a growing innovation pipeline supporting its outlook.

items.title: Fortive Raises 2026 Outlook as Core Growth and Cash Flow Accelerate
items.summary: Fortive raises its 2026 earnings outlook as broad organic growth, margin expansion and stronger cash flow support second-half momentum.
